title: Canonicality exceptions
description: The typed, time-limited exceptions to the canonicality doctrine, .ai/repo/knowledge/exceptions.yaml: each names the violation it excepts, why, who answers for it, the day it expires and how to tell it is no longer needed. An expired exception counts as a violation again.

id.description: The violation id, `<class>:<subject>`, as `majordomus canonicality check` prints it.

owner.description: A role or a team, never a machine path or a private address.

validation.description: How to tell the exception is no longer needed: a command, or what to look for.
